job.purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed hgi-idx-topk-tile-a-f87bdf90d-tc-cl (ot_hgi_topk_heap_tile, RTL f87bdf90d, snapshot of 2 drifted files): same RTL, outline 260.0x260.0, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Claude:el1011-hbm-idx

benches.name: heap_iw8w8_short_exact
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/ot_hgi_topk_heap_tile_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/ot_hgi_topk_heap_tile_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { bash tools/hgi_topk_heap_bench.sh {RUN}/bench/dropin -DIW=8 -DHW=8 -DSHORT
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the f87bdf90d snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/ot_hgi_topk_heap_tile_m5/src]
